title: dep-scan mcp scan_summary input
description: The arguments the scan_summary tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: one scan directory to summarise. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an unknown argument is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

scan_dir.description: The scan directory to summarise, as an absolute path. The tool refuses a path that does not resolve, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.
